items.title: 8.3 Ubharti technologies se Pakistan ke liye applications (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of designing applications for Pakistan (PDF 115-117).

blocks.text: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain Pakistan ke fauri masail hal karne ke naye tareeqe deti hain (Fig 8.6). Jiddat ko maqami samajh ke saath mila kar talaba aisi applications design kar sakte hain jo sehat, taleem, zara'at aur hukmrani mein zindagiyan behtar, paidawar zyada aur paidar taraqqi mein madad karein.

blocks.caption: Masail aur technology ke hal
rows: Mehdood rasai aur wasail ki kami
AI tez tashkhees ke liye tibbi data parakhti
Cloud tadreesi mawad kaar-amad tareeqe se mehfooz aur taqseem karta
IoT zameen aur mausam ki nigrani karta
Blockchain shaffaf, na-qabil-e-tabdeel sarkari records rakhta

blocks.text: In masail ko pehchanna mufeed hal ki taraf pehla qadam hai jo sarkari khidmat ko zyada zaheen, qabil-e-rasai aur qabil-e-aitbaar banate hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Technology Pakistan ke bare masail, jaise pani ki kami, taleem tak mehdood rasai aur sehat ki farahmi, mein madad kar sakti hai.

Design haqeeqi masle aur tools ke sahi milap se shuru hota hai: maslan zaheen tutoring ke liye AI, smart shehar ke intizam ke liye IoT, mehfooz data rasai ke liye cloud aur records ki tasdeeq ke liye blockchain. Design thinking talaba ko maqami halaat ke liye user-markooz, amli hal banane mein madad deti hai, aur pani ke intizam, traffic control ya taleem tak rasai ke projects tanqeedi soch banate aur biradariyon ki madad karte hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Kaghaz par ya digital tareeqe se aisi saadi app screen ka khaaka banayein jo AI, IoT ya cloud se haqeeqi masla hal kare.

Behtareen hal aksar technologies milate hain: AI ki zehanat, IoT ka rabta, cloud ki scalability aur blockchain ki hifazat mil kar data par mabni aise systems banati hain jo masail hal aur waqt ke saath behtar hote hain. Maslan smart aabpashi ka nizam zameen ki nami napne ke liye IoT sensors, fasal ki pani ki zaroorat ka andaza lagane ke liye AI, aur data jama aur tajzia karne ke liye cloud storage use karta hai, jis se kisan pani bachate, kharcha ghatate aur paidawar barhate hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Mile jule groups (technology, samaji uloom, karobar) banayein aur aisa mushtarka project design karein jo technology se biradari ka masla hal kare.

Pakistan ke liye hal us ki mukhtalif saqafaton, riwayat aur aqdar ka ehtram karein: applications shamooliyat wali, qabil-e-rasai aur maqami riwayat ki qadar karne wali hon, aur AI ilaqai tanawwo aur samaji hassasiyat ki akkas zaban aur mawad use kare. Data ka ghalat istemal, raazdari mein dakhal ya saqafati taur par na-munasib mawad be-aitmadi paida karta hai, is liye design insaf, ehtram aur musbat samaji asar ko farogh de.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Technology tab kaamyab hoti hai jab maqami riwayat, aqaid aur users ki zarooraton ka ehtram kare.
Case study: Pakistan mein smart zara'at

items: Zameen ki nigrani ke IoT sensors: zameen ki nami, darja hararat aur ghizaiyat ka foran data kisanon ko tay karne deta ke kab aur kitna pani dein, wasail bachate hue.
Mausam ke andaze ke liye AI: barish, khushk-sali ya darja hararat ke naqshon ka andaza kisanon ko mansooba bandi aur faslon ko mausami nuqsan se bachane deta, behtar paidawar aur kam nuqsan.
Data storage ke liye cloud: kisanon, researchers aur policy banane walon ke liye barhne wali storage aur zara'ati data tak tez rasai.
Supply chain ki shaffafiyat ke liye blockchain: paidawar aur taqseem ka har marhala record karna dhoka-dahi kam aur munsifana tijarat ko farogh deta.

blocks.alt: Khet mein IoT soil sensors (nami, darja hararat aur ghizaiyat napte) cloud storage ko data bhejte. Cloud AI andazon ke dabbe (barish, khushk-sali, pani ki zaroorat) se data ka tabadla karta, jo kisan ke phone ko mashwara bhejta: kab aur kitna pani. Neeche farm, market, shop aur buyer ke dabbe teeron se jure: blockchain har marhala record karta, munsifana, qabil-e-tatbeeq supply chain.
blocks.caption: IoT, cloud, AI aur blockchain milati smart zara'at (Fig 8.6 aur case study ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har technology aik kaam achha karti hai; mil kar yeh khet ki kachi pemaishon ko kisan ke mashware aur khareedar ke bharose mein badalti hain.

blocks.prompt: Do ubharti technologies use kar ke kisi Pakistani shehar ke traffic masle ke liye mukhtasar khayal design karein, aur aik akhlaqi masla batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: IoT cameras aur sarak ke sensors chauraho par gariyan ginte, aur AI data se signal ka waqt badalti aur rush ka andaza lagati, nataij cloud wali app mein. Akhlaqi masla raazdari hai: number plates parhne wale cameras logon ka data mehfooz rakhein aur sirf traffic ke intizam ke liye use hon.
